title: Simultaneous binding of quercetin and catechin to FOXO3 enhances IKKalpha transcription inhibition and suppression of oxidative stress-induced acute alcoholic liver injury in rats.
authors: Guan, Hui; Zhang, Wenyuan; Liu, Hui; Jiang, Yang; Li, Feng; Wang, Dan; Liu, Yang; He, Fatao; Wu, Maoyu; Ivan Neil Waterhouse, Geoffrey; Sun-Waterhouse, Dongxiao; Li, Dapeng
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和光谱实验验证槲皮素与儿茶素同时结合转录因子FOXO3并影响其与IKKalpha启动子结合，涉及TF-DNA互作但以湿实验为主，AI/物理模拟方法仅作辅助验证。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Oxidative stress is one of the major contributors to acute alcoholic liver injury (AALI), which is a common alcoholic liver disease. Quercetin and catechin are flavonoid antioxidants present in plant foods and possess chemopreventive and chemotherapeutic activities. Quercetin and catechin are often included in the same meal and ingested together. While they show cooperative actions against oxidative damage, the underlying mechanisms behind their counteracting effects against oxidative stress-induced AALI remain poorly understood. OBJECTIVES: The aim of this study was to understand the mechanism underlying the enhanced antioxidant effect of quercetin-catechin combination to alleviate AALI in rats. METHODS: The ethanol (EtOH)-treated rats and H(2)O(2)-treated liver cells were used to demonstrate the enhanced antioxidant effect of quercetin and catechin. Then we used RNA-sequencing to compare quercetin alone, catechin alone and quercetin-catechin combination and then identified the critical role of IKKalpha combining with gene silencing and overexpression techniques. Its transcription factor, FOXO3 was found through yeast one-hybrid assay, luciferase reporter assay, EMSA and ChIP assay. Finally, the interaction between quercetin, catechin and FOXO3 was verified through molecular docking, UV-Vis absorption spectroscopy, fluorescence spectroscopy, and CD spectroscopy. RESULTS: The study demonstrated the enhanced antioxidant effect of a quercetin-catechin combination in EtOH-treated rats and in H(2)O(2)-treated liver cells. Quercetin and catechin cooperatively inhibited IKKalpha/p53 pathway and activated Nrf2 signaling pathway. IKKalpha was a critical negative regulator in their joint action. FOXO3 bound to IKKalpha promoter to regulate IKKalpha transcription. Quercetin and catechin influenced FOXO3-IKKalpha binding through attaching directly to FOXO3 at different sites and altering FOXO3's secondary structures. CONCLUSION: Our study revealed the mechanism of quercetin and catechin against oxidative stress-induced AALI through jointly interacting with transcription factor. This research opens new vistas for examining the joint effect of therapeutics towards functional proteins and confirms the chemopreventive effects of multiple flavonoids via co-regulation.
abstract_zh: 引言：氧化应激是急性酒精性肝损伤（AALI）的主要诱因之一，而AALI是一种常见的酒精性肝病。槲皮素和儿茶素是存在于植物性食品中的类黄酮抗氧化剂，具有化学预防和化学治疗活性。槲皮素和儿茶素常在同一餐中摄入并共同吸收。尽管它们对氧化损伤表现出协同作用，但其对抗氧化应激诱导的AALI的潜在机制仍知之甚少。目的：本研究旨在了解槲皮素-儿茶素组合增强抗氧化效果以缓解大鼠AALI的机制。方法：使用乙醇（EtOH）处理的大鼠和H(2)O(2)处理的肝细胞来证明槲皮素和儿茶素的增强抗氧化效果。随后，我们利用RNA测序比较了单独槲皮素、单独儿茶素及槲皮素-儿茶素组合，并结合基因沉默和过表达技术确定了IKKalpha的关键作用。通过酵母单杂交实验、荧光素酶报告基因实验、EMSA和ChIP实验发现了其转录因子FOXO3。最后，通过分子对接、紫外-可见吸收光谱、荧光光谱和圆二色谱验证了槲皮素、儿茶素与FOXO3之间的相互作用。结果：研究证明了槲皮素-儿茶素组合在EtOH处理的大鼠和H(2)O(2)处理的肝细胞中具有增强的抗氧化效果。槲皮素和儿茶素协同抑制IKKalpha/p53通路并激活Nrf2信号通路。IKKalpha是它们联合作用中的关键负调控因子。FOXO3结合IKKalpha启动子以调节IKKalpha转录。槲皮素和儿茶素通过直接附着于FOXO3的不同位点并改变FOXO3的二级结构，影响FOXO3-IKKalpha结合。结论：我们的研究揭示了槲皮素和儿茶素通过联合作用于转录因子对抗氧化应激诱导的AALI的机制。这项研究为检查治疗药物对功能蛋白的联合效应开辟了新视野，并证实了多种类黄酮通过共调控发挥化学预防作用。
